實看：三主峰、左晨光、白金雲海與鐘樓可讀；旗面抽象紋樣只作候選，三宗正式旗紋未鎖。
實看：左欄/右梯口及下方院地可讀，空場足夠；欄杆與梁柱紋樣待與反向圖比對。
實看：維持右梯口、左下院地，向下視線更清楚；是同側俯角B而非180度反打，不證明每塊木紋對齊。
實看：左廣場右門和晨光清楚，三個主踏階可讀，門框冠頂有足夠餘地；三宗旗紋仍候選。
實看：階頂向外空廣場、門柱右前及反向晨光可讀；踏階在此角被壓扁，精確踏面仍以master/後續人物落腳格核對。
實看：三席西/東/北、南側空位及三色旗清楚；桌透視較寬，正式正投影仍須鎖正方尺寸。
實看：門左、柱後右、夕光自右，空間可容雙人；裝飾新增旗只作候選、不帶文字或宗派答案。
實看：南門在後，東西席交換畫面左右，西窗光改畫右，北旗未錯入反打；桌紋與master基本同族但未做幾何鎖圖。
實看：左岸右海、近海綠商船與遠灰帆船、右夕光與山灯方向可讀；跳板接到船首的升高幅度偏小，洛須留高船首，不能站跳板。
實看：左山壁右廊柱與月光、關門可讀；末端門是正對鏡頭，屬轉角端部，人物送茶需以此地理參照維持相同門。
實看：低岸與高船首、同商船/灰帆遠船可讀；跳板仍像固定棧橋，登船連接需關鍵格精確處理。
實看v2：裸梅枝已正確，左月門右亮窗維持；供傍晚入夜，深夜另用暗窗版。
實看：右窗完全暗、無暖灯，左門裸樹保留；本空景不證明角色在/不在房內。
實看：古式淺盤油灯及裸枝修正，左床右窗位置保留；床褥數量需逐鏡取景鎖定。
實看：四箭三長一短、黑弓/一囊/紅黑絲弦及釘子可辨；斷弦細節放大不是同比例，箭囊與長箭容納尺寸需工程比例卡，不能把此排版當同尺度。
實看：黑漆扁匣、銀蕨及閉/開兩態清楚，无字降書保留後製；兩視圖單一物件，不是劇中兩匣。
實看：三物不混，刀形/紅穗沿原圖，直劍/黑鞘無雕花，鉗雙臂單軸可辨；刃長與鞘內尺寸、鉗夾四箭仍須持物格檢視。
實看：棋/白子/一燭兩態可讀，但棋格非可信19路且多子未準確落交點，不能作棋盤近景母圖；需修為標準棋盤及落點。
實看：每態一盤一壺一杯，完整→傾翻可讀；此器形較場景cold初版更清楚，正式插鏡以本板並鎖傾倒方向。
實看：白貝錢圓孔、側面及燒焦灰紫布偶可辨；板上貝錢放大不是與娃娃等比例，不作大小比。
實看：雙頸後月牙位置/開口方向一致、無正臉或身份答案；膚色/髮與領只定位，正式兩鏡須再對位同尺寸，非長駐人像。
實看：風牆無可識別正臉、冠或人體，灰燼流向可讀；此板只定無形風紋，非事件動畫或身份證據。
實看v2：白玉外骨與末段鬆繩已修，3→2+1枚硬數量清楚；扇墜/細紋仍需與角色detail選同一母版，不可雙套各自採用。
實看v3：爐槽大部為暗石、不再通段發光，爐火侷限口內；左爐右空場保留，血滴局部需依source另構首尾格。
實看v2：槽全段暗石、微紅污痕，已去熔岩感；是南側近角B，維持同軸。
實看v2：五指完整留白、右手背/拇指在畫左、線畫風與單一道金斜線成立；線束為一筆紋理，不能延伸成完整符咒；位置/大小仍候選。
實看v3：樹景已去且大部分為紙面，但上右仍有淡月輪殘影；修訂未完全達no visible moon，列待修，不能用作紙窗近景母圖。
實看v2：窗面已較平整、無清楚外景；保留同側斜角地理，但非180度反向，仍須與master窗格/棋點鎖定。
實看v2：已維持燭滅/門開/翻盤一壺一杯和霜，但上右仍透淡月輪，不能稱紙窗已完全修妥。只適用a05-s031/s035/s042翻盤之後，不能當s023剛入房首格。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, soaked to the skin and shivering, his lopsided topknot collapsed with the cheap copper pin hanging loose, wet hair plastered to his forehead and neck. Patched ochre and brown layered robe dark and dripping with seawater, a coarse grey wool blanket wrapped around his shoulders, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, the wide straw hat hanging soaked down his back by its cord. Hunched over, clutching the blanket closed.

Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes now red-rimmed and watery, nose and cheeks flushed with fever, his lopsided topknot loosened and sagging with the cheap copper pin askew. A plain off-white padded inner robe under a thick patched indigo quilt wrapped around his shoulders like a cape, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string tied at his waist, no straw hat. Half-crouched and sniffling, still listening.

Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head under a tall gilded lotus crown with hanging gold bead strands, thick dark brows, fierce wide amber eyes, his face drained grey-pale with cold sweat at the temples. Layered saffron and crimson kasaya over a dark undershirt, a heavy embroidered collar with gold flame patterns, the kasaya and undershirt torn open over the left chest where a palm-sized blue-green star-shaped arrow scar glows faintly on the bare skin over his heart, no arrow and no blood, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura around his palms.

Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head bare with no crown, thick dark brows, wide amber eyes gone dull and heavy-lidded, his face pale and drawn. A plain grey monk's robe loosely closed over a white undershirt, no kasaya and no embroidered collar, the loose neckline showing the edge of a blue-green star-shaped arrow scar on the skin over his heart, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura. His broad shoulders slump; he cannot sit straight without support.

Original 2D anime noblewoman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall elegant woman who looks thirty, waist-length silver-white hair worn loose under a towering black-and-silver phoenix crown with trailing silver chains, pale face, long narrow eyes with violet shadow, a small frost-flower mark at the outer corner of her left eye, a small crescent birthmark on the back of her neck usually hidden under her hair. Black layered court robe embroidered with white frost ferns, long sweeping sleeves, a deep violet outer mantle. A slim black lacquered bow strung with a plain black cord slung across her back, and a lidded black lacquered quiver hanging at her right hip. Stands at the head of her people with the same dignity as she kneels.

Original 2D anime master smith in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: massive old man, scarred bare chest under a soot-black leather apron and a rust-red embroidered half-robe, grey hair cropped short under a burnt iron band, left eye clouded white, forearms covered in burn scars. The back of his right hand pierced clean through by a raw, rust-crusted nail wound, dried blood streaked down his right wrist and forearm. He carries no forge tongs. Hunched over himself like a man serving a sentence.

Original 2D anime wuxia strategist in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall slender man in his thirties, very long straight ink-black hair unbound and spread loose over the pillow and his shoulders, no crown and no crane-feather pin, pale face gone grey-white with dark hollows under the eyes, narrow grey eyes closed or half-open and unfocused, dry colourless lips. A plain undyed white silk inner robe loosely closed at the collar, no embroidered outer robe, no sash, no fan and no weapon. Lies on his back without moving; his breathing is shallow and his hands rest empty at his sides.

Original 2D anime mute swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: lean young man in his late twenties, black hair tied high with a plain iron ring, the tail below the ring cut off bluntly so it now ends at his shoulders, pale face with a thin old scar across the left cheek, dark watchful eyes. Charcoal and slate layered robe with narrow white embroidered trim, sleeves bound tight at the wrists, one straight sword in a plain black scabbard worn across his back with the hilt above his right shoulder. Stands very still and speaks only with small hand signs.

Original 2D anime Taoist swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: thin wiry man of indeterminate age, long grey-streaked black hair in a high topknot under a small dark-green crown carved with bamboo leaves, a few strands fallen loose across his brow, sharp narrow eyes, a short pointed grey-black beard. Layered moss-green and black Taoist robe embroidered with bamboo stalks and silver star charts, faded, torn at the hem and grey with road dust up to the knees, a dark-green sash with a white horsetail whisk tucked in it, a plain straight sword in a dark-green scabbard at his left hip. Nothing on his back. Walks like a man who has crossed half the realm without sleeping.

Original 2D anime Taoist swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: thin wiry man of indeterminate age, long grey-streaked black hair in a high topknot under a small dark-green crown carved with bamboo leaves, a few strands fallen loose across his brow, sharp narrow eyes, a short pointed grey-black beard. Layered moss-green and black Taoist robe embroidered with bamboo stalks and silver star charts, faded, torn at the hem and grey with road dust up to the knees, a dark-green sash with a white horsetail whisk tucked in it, nothing at his left hip but the dark-green sash. Nothing on his back. Walks like a man who has crossed half the realm without sleeping.

Original 2D anime melancholy clerk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: pale thin young scholar in his late twenties, long black hair worn loose and slightly unkempt under a low ash-grey scholar's cap, hollow cheeks, tired dark eyes with a faint smile. Layered grey and faded indigo robe with worn embroidered borders, ink stains on the right cuff, a white cloth bandage wound over his left shoulder and showing at the collar, a dark bloodstain soaked through the robe at the left shoulder, his left arm held stiff against his side, an official's wooden tally hanging at his belt beside a small sealed wine gourd. Unarmed. Stands a little stooped.

Original 2D anime melancholy clerk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: pale thin young scholar in his late twenties, long black hair worn loose and slightly unkempt under a low ash-grey scholar's cap, hollow cheeks, tired dark eyes with a faint smile. Layered grey and faded indigo robe with worn embroidered borders, ink stains on the right cuff, the edge of a white bandage showing at the left side of his collar, his left arm held a little stiff, a small sealed wine gourd at his belt and no tally. Unarmed. Stands a little stooped.

Original 2D anime mountain hermit in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall weathered man in his fifties, long steel-grey hair worn loose and tangled under a plain dark-blue cloth crown knocked slightly askew, deep-set eyes heavy with exhaustion, a long thin scar across the bridge of the nose, skin burned dark by wind and snow, now drained grey and beaded with sweat. Layered robe of deep ocean blue and storm grey with embroidered rolling-wave hems, torn open across the chest and ripped ragged at both forearms, grey rock dust on his shoulders and hems, the heavy fur-lined travel mantle of dark grey fur torn and slipping off his left shoulder, a plain long sword in a worn dark-blue scabbard at his left hip. Still on his feet, but only just; every breath comes hard.

Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so that his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps turned back to show the inner lining embroidered with the twin-abyss crest of the Red Abyss Palace, two dark whirlpools side by side in bronze thread; a bronze-brown sash, long trailing sleeves, both arms whole, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and keeps smiling.

Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile gone pale, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps turned back to show the inner lining embroidered with the twin-abyss crest of the Red Abyss Palace, two dark whirlpools side by side in bronze thread; his left arm hangs limp and useless, the left sleeve soaked dark with blood from shoulder to cuff; a bronze-brown sash, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and does not hurry.

Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile gone pale, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps pulled closed over his chest and held there by his right hand so the lining is hidden, only a thin glint of bronze thread showing between his fingers; his left arm hangs limp and useless, the left sleeve soaked dark with blood from shoulder to cuff; a bronze-brown sash, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and does not hurry.
